ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.
   C. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   B. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
